title: RREP hop_count unbounded - input validation gap
description:
Location: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs line 418

Issue: Unlike RREQ hop_limit which is clamped to MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15) at line 348 to prevent flood amplification, RREP hop_count is read verbatim without validation.

Security Impact: While RREP messages require signatures (preventing forgery), a misbehaving signed node could send RREP with hop_count=0 claiming to be 0 hops from destination. If routing logic prefers lower hop_count, attackers route gets selected.

Suggested Fix: Add validation consistent with RREQ: hop_count = data[1].min(MAX_HOP_LIMIT)
